description: Scenario: newsreader client uses NEWGROUPS to poll for newly available groups since its last connection. session/commands/list.rs::newgroups receives (date, time) arguments but ignores them entirely, returning all known groups unconditionally. Consequence: clients that rely on NEWGROUPS for incremental discovery (all major clients use this) receive the full group list on every poll. For large group lists this is a significant bandwidth waste and can cause clients to flag spurious new-group notifications on every reconnect.
title: NEWGROUPS ignores since_timestamp — always returns all groups
